source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 485c41a phase removes the nsIMsgWindow.closeWindow API, its destructor call and its explicit callers. The removed native method performed docshell network-stop/listener cleanup and released its transaction manager. This is a different operation from DOM window.close. ComposeUnload still performs its other cleanup and closes the DOM window; searchOnUnload still closes its folder display and removes the controller. Later docshell and transaction-service changes explain the smaller fixed accepted nsMsgWindow. These source facts do not prove equivalent native shutdown or network behavior, and the changed tests only remove cleanup calls.
title: Removing nsIMsgWindow.closeWindow does not remove DOM closure or other caller cleanup
